input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligations into Article XXI (Effect of Termination).
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to return Licensor materials, with nothing on our side coming back. We added an orderly exit: up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. We can work with 90 days of assistance if six months is a problem.

ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such request, return to Licensee all data and records of Licensee, and all trade, order and account data generated by or on behalf of Licensee, in Licensor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law or regulation.
